Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

Snyk's Product Security team works consultatively with the engineering teams that build and run our cloud platform: we identify the security requirements, agree together on what needs to change, and the owning teams implement it. As a Senior Product Security Engineer (Platform), you'll pair deep GCP and AWS infrastructure experience with AI coding agents to turn threat models into concrete Terraform, Kubernetes, and pipeline fixes, then work directly with platform teams to get those fixes merged. The goal is simple to state and hard to do well: make the secure option the easy option for the engineers building Snyk's platform.

 

About the Team

You'll join Snyk's Product Security team, which operates as an advisor rather than an owner: the cloud infrastructure teams retain ownership and operation of their systems, and Product Security's job is to find what needs to change and make that change easy to ship. The team sits close to Snyk's platform and infrastructure organization and is increasingly built around AI agents doing real infrastructure work, not just reviewing someone else's.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Threat model Snyk's cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS to identify the security requirements platform teams need to meet, then negotiate the resulting changes directly with the teams that own the systems.

  • Use AI coding agents (for example Claude Code) to draft the Terraform, Kubernetes, and pipeline changes that fix identified security gaps, and raise them for the owning team to review and merge.

  • Run agent-driven fixes at scale across many repositories, scoping every change so the owning platform team can review and merge it with confidence.

  • Write and maintain the guidance AI agents rely on (skills, prompts, instruction files, security baselines) so agent output consistently matches Snyk's standards.

  • Connect agents to live cloud, CSPM, and ticketing data through MCP servers, command-line tools, and provider APIs so their fixes are grounded in the real environment.

  • Review AI-generated infrastructure changes critically: catch invented resources, unsafe defaults, and IAM permissions scoped wider than they need to be.

  • Harden GCP identity and access management, including the resource hierarchy, IAM roles and conditions, service accounts and workload identity federation, and organization policy constraints, plus the AWS IAM equivalent.

  • Improve Kubernetes and container security, primarily on GKE: cluster hardening (private clusters, Autopilot), RBAC, admission control, workload identity, network policy, and secure container image pipelines (Artifact Registry, Binary Authorization).

  • Add automated security testing and CSPM tooling to CI/CD and GitOps pipelines, then help teams triage and fix what those tools surface.

  • Benchmark infrastructure against secure configuration baselines such as the CIS Google Cloud Foundation Benchmark, and against the infrastructure controls in frameworks like ISO 27001 and NIST 800-53.

  • Limit the risks AI agents themselves introduce: prompt injection, over-broad permissions, leaked secrets, and changes made without review.

  • Measure whether agent-driven fixing is actually working across teams, and improve the approach as you learn what does and doesn't land.

 

What you’ll bring

  • 5-8 years running or securing cloud infrastructure, ideally having built and operated production platforms on GCP or AWS before moving into security.

  • Deep, hands-on GCP knowledge, including its security services, plus a good working knowledge of AWS; equivalent AWS IAM depth is a bonus.

  • Strong grasp of GCP IAM: resource hierarchy (organization, folders, projects), IAM roles and conditions, service accounts and workload identity federation, organization policy constraints, and least privilege design.

  • Practical Kubernetes and container experience, primarily GKE: cluster hardening (private clusters, Autopilot), RBAC, admission control, workload identity, network policy, and secure container images. EKS experience is also welcome.

  • Comfort with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and automated deployment: CI/CD pipelines and GitOps.

  • Solid DevSecOps practice: threat modeling, early shift-left testing, and continuous monitoring, plus the judgment to turn that into concrete infrastructure changes.

  • Confidence using AI coding agents (for example Claude Code) day to day, including writing the guidance and prompts that keep their output reliable at scale.

  • A critical eye for AI-generated infrastructure output: able to spot invented resources, unsafe defaults, and overly broad IAM permissions before anything ships.

  • Comfort working consultatively: influencing and negotiating changes with teams who own and run the infrastructure, rather than owning it yourself.

  • Nice to have: application security knowledge (for example code review, OWASP Top 10), or experience with Snyk's products or similar security testing tools.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

Snyk is looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to own day-to-day revenue and marketplace operations, monthly close procedures, and revenue accounting. This is a highly visible role on our Quote-to-Cash finance team, working closely with stakeholders across the organization to ensure timely and accurate accounting of revenue (ASC 606) and related contract costs. Beyond core reporting, you will independently drive strategic system and process improvements and lead high priority projects, including NetSuite integration improvements and revenue metric visualization and calculation in Sigma and Claude. You will act as a crucial translator between raw data and actionable insights, ensuring our financial systems scale with Snyk's growth.

 

About the Team

You'll join Snyk's Quote-to-Cash finance team, which owns the accuracy and scalability of revenue accounting from deal structuring through financial reporting. The team partners closely with Deal Desk, Strategy Ops, FP&A, and Business Applications to keep Snyk's revenue systems and processes running smoothly as the company scales.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead workstreams within special projects, such as implementing Sigma and Claude Skills to automate revenue reporting and controls and to visualize key performance metrics.

  • Own the evaluation of the accounting impact of contract restructures and modifications, confirming they are treated appropriately in NetSuite.

  • Own key month end processes, including review of subscription data within NetSuite and final fluctuation analyses by customer.

  • Design, perform, and automate data reconciliations across critical system integrations, independently monitoring and resolving data flow discrepancies.

  • Partner with the Business Applications team to define and drive ongoing process improvements and enhancements across the Quote-to-Cash technical stack, including Salesforce, Zone Billing, and NetSuite ARM.

  • Advise Deal Desk, Strategy Ops, and FP&A on accounting matters and deal structures, including contract cancellations, driving issues through to resolution.

  • Perform SSP analysis and own updates to revenue recognition rules and allocations as needed.

  • Manage the preparation and review of audit support schedules, serving as a primary point of contact for financial audit inquiries.

  • Prepare and review key revenue reports and financial metrics, including external quarterly and annual financial reporting disclosures such as ARR and related metrics, RPO, and disaggregated revenue.

 

What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting. CPA a plus.

  • 2-3+ years of experience in revenue accounting or public accounting.

  • Working knowledge of ASC 606 principles and internal controls, with the ability to apply them independently.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite ARM and Salesforce.

  • Experience with Sigma, Claude, and Zone Billing highly preferred.

  • Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

  • A natural ability to break down complex problems into actionable tasks and drive them to resolution with minimal oversight.

  • Incredible attention to detail, particularly regarding contract analysis, reconciliations, and audit schedules.

  • An agile mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, especially around automating key processes via Sigma, Claude, system automation, or other AI tools.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

Millions of developers now build software faster than ever, and that speed creates risk at a scale security teams have never had to absorb. As a Technical Success Manager (TSM) at Snyk, you will be the technical champion for a large portfolio of customers, helping them embed security directly into their development workflows and hit their DevSecOps goals on the Snyk platform. This is trusted advisory work at scale: you will use usage data and programmatic, high-impact engagements to help hundreds of customers unlock real business value rather than covering a handful of accounts one at a time.

About the Team

You will join the Technical Success team inside Snyk's Customer Experience organization, reporting into Technical Success leadership. The team owns technical outcomes and adoption across our highest-volume customer segment, running scaled programs, workshops, and digital enablement instead of one-to-one coverage. We work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Support, Product, and Education so that what we learn from customers actually reaches the people who can act on it.

What You’ll Do

  • Own technical success for a large portfolio of customers, running scheduled sessions focused on technical and business outcomes so every account in your book realizes increasing value from Snyk.

  • Lead one-to-many engagements including technical workshops, office hours, and best-practice webinars that build a strong and self-sufficient user community.

  • Turn data into action by analyzing customer usage to uncover trends, spot risk early, and trigger targeted programmatic outreach before a problem becomes an escalation.

  • Drive scalable adoption through programs that get new customers to their first security wins quickly, then keep them progressing toward a mature DevSecOps practice.

  • Build a library of success: create and curate tutorials, best-practice guides, and videos that let customers self-serve and succeed independently.

  • Act as the voice of your customer portfolio, synthesizing feedback from hundreds of customers into clear themes that influence the product roadmap.

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Support, and Education to solve common needs at the segment level rather than account by account.

  • Coach customers on embedding SAST, SCA, and secrets, container, and IaC scanning into the developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines they already use.

  • Help customers think through securing AI-generated code and AI-assisted development, an area where most teams are still writing their playbook and genuinely want a guide.

  • Measure what works by tracking engagement and outcome metrics for your programs, then doubling down on the ones that move adoption.

  • What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as customer success, solutions engineering, technical account management, or professional services.

  • A scalable mindset: proven experience designing and executing one-to-many programs like webinars, email campaigns, digital journeys, or workshops.

  • Working knowledge of developer tools (for example GitHub, Jira, Jenkins, VS Code) and a real understanding of how code moves from commit to production.

  • Understanding of Application Security concepts including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and secrets, container, and IaC scanning.

  • DevSecOps acumen: hands-on experience with DevOps tooling and a foundational understanding of the DevSecOps lifecycle.

  • Technical curiosity, including a genuine interest in AI, developer workflows, and Application Security, plus working fluency with AI-assisted tools such as Claude or Gemini.

  • Effective and influential written and verbal communication, with the range to be credible with developers, security leads, and executive sponsors alike.

  • Exceptional organization and time management, with the ability to hold competing priorities in a high-volume environment.

  • Nice to have: a builder's background, whether that is time spent as a developer or hands-on work with coding and agentic AI systems.

  • Nice to have: the instincts of a natural educator, the kind of curiosity that pushes you to understand how something works and then makes you want to help someone else get it.

    • Nice to have: hands-on experience with AppSec programs such as threat modeling or vulnerability management, and familiarity with OWASP or NIST frameworks.

  • Nice to have: scripting experience or a track record of digital program transformation.

  • Nice to have: relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or Security+.

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
